Park Rules
If you find the need to cancel your reservation, here are the details of our revised cancellation policy:
1. Cancellations initiated more than 14 days before your scheduled arrival date are eligible for a refund, but a cancellation fee of $45 will be deducted.
2. For cancellations made within 14 days of your expected arrival date, no monetary refund will be provided. However, you will receive a credit that can be used for future camping. This credit, valid for one year, will be granted after deducting a $45 change fee.
3. Please note that any further date alterations will incur an additional $45 change fee each time.
No refunds due to weather or early departure.
